newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel flat as supply continues to pressure.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel flat as supply continues to pressure.

text.p: NWE jet fuel oil was little changed on Friday as moderate benchmark IPE gas oil gains firmed the outright price slightly but premiums remained in the doldrums, traders said.
July gas oil ended 25 cents higher at $162.75 a tonne.
Barge material was talked at July IPE +$14.50/+$15.50 fob ARA.
Traders said sloppy supplies were continuing to put pressure on prices.

"I think the German tender encouraged players to stock up on jet barges but then the requirements were met by cargoes," said one trader referring to the EBV compulsory oil stocks agency tender for 250,000 tonnes of jet fuel from May to end September.
Traders said the problem was being further exacerbated by the weak low sulphur market.
"If the low sulphur market wasn't so dreary refiners could maybe make more low sulphur at the expense of jet fuel but they're both dreary," said another trader.
Activity on the cargo side was minimal. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
